description: This is a React component source file that implements a detailed UI for displaying network resource details within a trace viewer. It includes components for headers, payload, and response details, providing functionalities like copying requests in various formats, expandable sections, and rendering of response media such as images and fonts.

methods.name: statusClass
methods.description: Returns a CSS class name based on the HTTP status code to indicate success, redirection, or error.

methods.name: formatBody
methods.description: Formats response body content based on its content type for display purposes, handling JSON prettification and URL decoding.
